$Comment: On the List: reach Friendly on Santa's Nice List, the rank the list calls On the List, and collect
Earned once and kept: no Parent, so no yearly copy, and no merry tag. Favor on the Nice List carries
from one Christmas to the next, so a yearly copy would pay the gift again every year. REPUTATION_RANK
credits every rank a player's favor has reached, each time their favor changes and when they log in.
Target is the rank id and Qualifier the reputation id. The criterion's TextKey words the step with the
list's own rank name. The _Christmas folder makes the id christmas_on_the_list, and its words come from
The gift waits in Rewards.Claim on the achievements page until the player collects it: Christmas
Coins, two Christmas Presents and candy canes, and MMO Skill Tree's Mmo_Boost_Token, a quarter more XP
in every skill for half an hour, which the player starts when it suits them. The token row's own
Requires, the hytale:mod_installed gate, leaves it out on a server without that mod, unpaid and
unshown, and the rest still pays.
